subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate coverage as sufficient proof for this xAI provider-side stale encrypted_content rotation, or require organic after-fix xAI gateway logs before merge?
rationale: The external-PR proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the author claims the exact code-less xAI decrypt error is provider-side and cannot be induced on demand; accepting that exception is a maintainer proof-sufficiency decision, not a code repair.

options.title: Accept Explicit Proof Override
options.body: If the area owner agrees the provider-side trigger cannot be induced, apply a proof override and land after branch refresh and normal checks because the code path is narrow and source-covered.

options.title: Require Organic After-Fix Logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future real xAI rotation event produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer-Owned Fix
options.body: Close or pause this contributor PR only if maintainers want to carry the same predicate/test change in a maintainer branch with their own proof decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Proof Override
recommendation.body: If the area owner agrees the provider-side trigger cannot be induced, apply a proof override and land after branch refresh and normal checks because the code path is narrow and source-covered.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the sibling retry recovery and is the strongest history signal for deciding proof sufficiency on this transport behavior.
